scrutiny.test: T0 purpose: prismis is read through the TUI (docs/IDEA.md: 'a sexy TUI for daily consumption'); a floor filter and a remembered view remove the key presses every reading session starts with.
scrutiny.failureCase: A change no reading session benefits from.

scrutiny.test: T1 owners: applyFiltersClientSide (tui/internal/ui/model.go:1454) is the one filter both modes use; getDefaultDBPath (tui/internal/db/queries.go:318) is the TUI's XDG pattern; the XDG Base Directory spec places restorable view state in XDG_STATE_HOME.
scrutiny.failureCase: A second filter path or a state file in the data directory.

scrutiny.test: T2 same noun: the 0-key decision rests on the production database (21,095 unread unprioritized vs 6,668 prioritized, 6 of 24 upvotes on unprioritized items), not on the issue's May-era description of a toggle that no longer exists.
T3 degrade: MEDIUM-only and LOW-only views go away, which gh #36 asks for, and stated as a sacrifice; the unprioritized-only view is kept because it is in use.
T4 reuse: the existing filter function, header builder, help row and XDG resolution pattern are extended; the persistence is one small reader/writer.
T5 running system: after install, launch the TUI against cerebro, set 2 + oldest + a source type, quit and relaunch: the header shows the same view and the list matches.
scrutiny.failureCase: Only unit tests of the filter.

scrutiny.test: T7 consumers, enumerated with grep for the 'all' priority value: model.go lines 28, 139, 707, 720, 1474 and the feed_test.go / model_test.go cases that construct it; all are inside the TUI and move together. The CLI's --priority (cli/src/cli/list.py) is an exact-match API filter used by scripts and the web view (static/index.html) has no selectable priority filter, so neither consumes this state.
scrutiny.failureCase: A reader of the removed 'all' value left behind.

scrutiny.test: T9 six months: a new view field must be added to the persisted set; the save compares the whole view struct, so a field added to the struct is saved without a second list to update.
scrutiny.failureCase: A hand-maintained field list that drifts.

scrutiny.test: T10 reversibility: revert the commit and delete one state file; no data or API change.

T11 class, priority filtering across surfaces: TUI (changed here), CLI --priority (exact match by design, for scripts), web (no selectable filter); Go is the only stack touched, Python untouched; engines axis n/a.
scrutiny.failureCase: The same reading-floor need left on another reading surface.

scrutiny.test: T13 two places: the visible set is computed once (applyFiltersClientSide) and the view is saved from one place in Update.
scrutiny.failureCase: Save calls scattered across key handlers.

scrutiny.test: T20 walk: the operator presses 2 then s then sets RSS, quits; tui-view.json holds priority medium, sort oldest, filter rss; next launch newModel reads it, the header reads 'Priority: MEDIUM+ | Sort: OLDEST | Filter: RSS'; pressing R writes the defaults; a corrupted file next launch shows the defaults and a status message naming the file.
